author: Laura Loomer
title: EXCLUSIVE VIDEO: Anti-Trump Capitol Hill Protests Intensify As Leftists Demand Someone "Luigi Mangione" President Trump and Elon Musk
text:
Demonstrators opposing President Trump on Capitol Hill expressed strong discontent towards Loomer Unleashed following inquiries regarding their posters, which advocated for acts of assassination against both President Trump and Elon Musk.
On Monday, a protest event against President Donald Trump and Elon Musk occurred on Capitol Hill, drawing demonstrators who voiced their opposition to both individuals. An exclusive video recorded by Loomer Unleashed features a protestor showcasing a poster that includes an image of Luigi from the Super Mario Brothers franchise, accompanied by the caption, “Elon, Don, Luigi Says: DENY, DEFEND, DEPOSE.”
It is essential to acknowledge that the phrase “Deny, Defend, Depose” was inscribed on the bullets discharged by Luigi Mangione, which resulted in the murder of United Healthcare Chief Executive Officer Brian Thompson.
After Loomer Unleashed inquired about the significance of the protester’s pro-Luigi Mangione sign, other protesters began to converge on Loomer Unleashed correspondent Charles Downs. They took photographs of him, labeled him as an extremist, and attempted to seize and damage his phone.
Elon Musk commented on Loomer Unleashed’s video, which depicted protesters issuing direct threats against himself and President Donald Trump. Musk wrote on his X account, “Advocating murder of the President is a serious crime and they have the gall to do so on President’s Day! Letting @EagleEdMartin know about this.”
In a separate discussion regarding the footage from Loomer Unleashed, Elon Musk stated, “They are going way too far. A man was actually murdered by Luigi and they tried to kill the President twice. This is not ok at all.”
Elon Musk’s comment was in response to Laura Loomer’s post, which highlighted the Women’s March’s support for the protest that occurred on Capitol Hill Monday. A portion of the Women’s March’s Instagram post stated, “Women’s March is in solidarity with local feminist leaders and everyday people taking action on Monday, Feb. 17, as part of the Not My President – No Kings in America national actions. While our country faces an administrative coup led by Trump and his billionaire allies, this fight for our democracy calls for all of us to do everything we can to protect our freedoms. Across the country, people are rising up in decentralized actions to make their opposition heard. We encourage everyone to find or organize an action in their community and add their voice to this fight.”
One of the primary organizers of the protest on Capitol Hill Monday is an entity referred to as 50501. According to the information available on 50501’s website, an organization named Political Revolution is listed as one of its partners.
The mission page on the Political Revolution website suggests that the organization played a significant role in Bernie Sanders’ presidential campaigns. According to the mission statement, “Our founders also initiated Sanders for President, the foremost online community dedicated to Senator Sanders’s presidential bid. Through the efforts of volunteers alone, this organization raised over $10 million and engaged millions of individuals each month.”
It is important to highlight that the donation page on the Political Revolution website prominently features an image of Bernie Sanders. Donors contribute to this page through ActBlue, which is widely regarded as the primary fundraising platform for elected Democrats.
The Political Revolution platform features a comprehensive list of candidates who have received endorsements from various national organizations. These organizations include Our Revolution, Brand New Congress, Democratic Socialists of America, Justice Democrats, the Political Revolution itself, and the Progressive Change Campaign. The website reads, “This is a listing of Progressive candidates endorsed by national groups to include Our Revolution, Brand New Congress, Democratic Socialists of America, Justice Democrats, the Political Revolution, and Progressive Change Campaign. Where two candidates are running for the same seat, only the candidate endorsed in 2022 is listed.”
The list of Congressional Democrats featured on Political Revolution’s campaigns page includes Representative Rashida Tlaib from Michigan. During her tenure in Congress, she has encountered significant criticism for her support of pro-Hamas policies.
Loomer Unleashed captured footage of the Palestinian flag being displayed during the protest organized by 50501 on Capitol Hill Monday.
It will be interesting to observe whether Congressional Democrats distance themselves from the protest that took place on Capitol Hill on Monday.
